GOV-F-004-S15.title: Append-Only Enforcement and Write Constraints
GOV-F-004-S15.description: Implement database-level and service-level constraints to guarantee append-only behavior, preventing updates or deletes of audit records.
GOV-F-004-S15.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py; ASSUMPTION: MongoDB collections currently allow mutation. GAP: No append-only enforcement exists.

GOV-F-004-S16.title: Hash Chaining and Tamper Detection
GOV-F-004-S16.description: Extend audit schema to include previous-record hash and compute chained hashes for each entry to enable tamper detection and audit integrity validation.
GOV-F-004-S16.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; ASSUMPTION: No cryptographic chaining currently implemented. GAP: Missing tamper-evident logging.

GOV-F-004-S17.title: Audit Logging Failure Handling and Fallbacks
GOV-F-004-S17.description: Implement fail-safe mechanisms to ensure audit events are not lost, including retry logic, fallback logging, and error surfacing when audit writes fail.
GOV-F-004-S17.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py; Code/Shared/cost_guard.py; ASSUMPTION: Current logging does not guarantee durability under failure. GAP: No retry/fallback mechanism.
